narrow down: reduce the number of choices or things in a range
typical: narrow sth down (to sth). NOT for: expanding.
The police have narrowed down their list of suspects.
I've narrowed it down to two people.
nod off: fall asleep, usually without meaning to
typical: nod off in front of sth. NOT for: staying awake.
I missed the film because I kept nodding off.
He nodded off in the meeting.
note down: write something down so you remember it
typical: note sth down. NOT for: remembering without writing.
Note down the main points for your essay.
